mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the past month signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL annualized increase exceeds 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (GDPC1) signals strong economic demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 shows a 3-month increase.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points in the past month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past two months signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by more than 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the past two months signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where HOUST increases by more than 5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the Unemployment Rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, the combination signals a tight labor market with high interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with low unemployment
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in the past month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS decreases by more than 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: When Real Personal Consumption Expenditures (GDPC1) increase by more than 2% over the past quarter and Housing Starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% over the past two months, the combined signal indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increase > 2% in 3 months and HOUST increase > 5% in 2 months
regime_hint: economic expansion with strong housing demand
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 increases by more than 2% and HOUST increases by more than 5%.
